notes: Layered underworld Desert Entry background for the opening Egypt Journey scene. The playable stone path is a dedicated world-locked route layer, while the eclipse sky, floating pyramid wasteland, corrupted temple ruins, and foreground corruption build the mirror-world/Duat collapse behind and in front of Asha.
groundLaneNote: Dedicated underworld stone path layer. Drawn at parallax 1.0 (locked to the world / collision floor) so Asha runs on the same visible route that collision, enemies, shards, checkpoints, and gates use.
coordinateNote: The active runtime uses layered 2172x724 PNGs. Background layers scroll with parallax for depth; groundLane scrolls at gameplay speed and remains the visible source of truth for the walkable floor.
